title: Road construction
summary: Bitumen roads and concrete roads for yards, plants, and public work.
detail: The road is measured, laid, and finished so the next run is smoother. Bitumen and concrete are both done by the same crew.

title: Foundations
summary: Machine foundations, special foundations, and mass concrete.
detail: Foundations for plant and machinery, including the ones the ground or the machine asks for, and mass concrete besides the frames.

title: Floors
summary: Floor repairs and epoxy finishes for working sheds.
detail: Worn floors are repaired and finished in epoxy where the shed needs a surface that can take the work.

title: Walls and gabions
summary: Stone-filled gabion walls for slopes and channels.
detail: Gabion walls hold a slope or a channel. The stone stays in the mesh, and the line follows the ground.

title: Yards and plotting
summary: Parking bays, lines, signs, and plotting for a new site.
detail: A yard needs bays, lines, and signs before the machines move in. Plotting sets out a new site the same way.

title: Buildings
detail: Frames, brick, and masonry for a building. Reinforced concrete sits inside this work, not beside it as a separate trade.
